R455.note: Bounds check against MAX_FIELDS before the index is used, reusing the existing -1 error path; indices 4-15 still return the zeroed slots exactly as before.

R456.note: subtle.ConstantTimeCompare requires an exact byte-for-byte match, satisfying the stated contract; the empty-header guard and return semantics are unchanged.

R457.note: Restricting to a rooted relative path (no scheme, no authority) closes the open redirect, but rebuilding the target from rawPath+rawQuery silently drops any fragment, and absolute URLs to the app's own host are now rejected without that being called out as a legitimate-use loss.

R458.note: Replacing sh -c with archive/tar removes the shell entirely, but GNU tar -tf also auto-detects bzip2/xz/zstd/lzma and the fix only handles gzip, so those archives now return 500 while the write-up claims parity with tar's transparent decompression.

R459.note: unsubscribe() plus an RAII ScopedSubscription constructed after the observer guarantees removal before destruction; publish() order and live-observer semantics are unchanged (the duplicated class definitions across TUs pre-exist the fix).

R460.note: Switching to length-prefixed RESP bulk strings makes CR/LF/space literal argument data, the correct structural fix for a Redis client; same HSET key/field/value is sent and no response handling existed to alter.

R461.note: Static SecureRandom with the attacker-supplied seed removed; the only other change (seed parameter no longer read, so a missing seed no longer throws NumberFormatException) is the weakness itself and is stated plainly.

R462.note: Drop-in SecureRandom.nextDouble() with identical [0,1) contract, so token formatting, cookie, session storage and comparison are byte-for-byte the same shape as before.

R463.note: Argument list plus -- and a leading-dash reject close both shell and flag injection, but the added hostname allowlist (rejects e.g. underscores) and the new 10s timeout (iputils ping -c 4 to a silent host runs ~13s, so the most common diagnostic case now returns 504 instead of the packet-loss output) restrict inputs the original accepted, even though both are stated.

R464.note: self.get_object() resolves through the owner-scoped/staff-widened get_queryset() and runs check_object_permissions(), so non-owned ids still 404 rather than 403 as the contract requires, and the hand-built response is untouched.

R465.note: Ownership check against order.getCustomerUsername() via SecurityContextHolder before mutation and save; owners succeed as before, non-owners get AccessDeniedException (403), and existence disclosure via not-found vs success already existed in the original.
